workarounds.note: the imprint page's heading holds a 0.1 pt box, and the dedication's an ornament, so neither prints its title
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
the leaves and the front style restate breakBefore with parity 'any', or each would inherit level 1's odd break and a blank verso
every frontmatter value is quoted: the year prints on the title page through {publishDate}
the small-print style stays in ink, because a paragraph style's italic runs take bodyText.italicColor

the no-break spaces in the imprint (1 January 1818, eBook 41445, CC BY 4.0), the Preface (Dr. Darwin) and Letter I (St. Petersburgh) do not glue yet: the lines were checked so no pair splits; re-check after editing any of them

an opener's image elements never count towards the height the heading reserves (measureHeadingAdvancedDesignHeight lays the slot out without resources): Letter I's minHeight alone puts the first line under the drawing

a heading design that reaches below the text block's foot drops its whole reserved height, minHeight included (build.ts places the oversize heading at its text height): the cover's type ends above the foot
Fanwood Text has no bold and Cinzel no italic: the kit's provider snaps to the faces each family ships
